sloka: क्षिप्रं प्रहर निश्शङ्कं स्थिरां कीर्तिमवाप्नुहि ।ततस्त्वां ज्ञातविक्रान्तं नाशयिष्यामि वानर ।। ६.५९.५८ ।।।।
transliteration: kṣipraṁ prahara niśśaṅkaṁ sthirāṁ kīrtimavāpnuhi ।tatastvāṁ jñātavikrāntaṁ nāśayiṣyāmi vānara ।। 6.59.58 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Vanara! Go about without any hesitation. Attain the fame of a Vanara hitting Ravana permanently. Thereafter knowing your prowess, I shall put an end to you."
